## Visualización de percentiles (Ejemplo 5)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.5

# Parámetros
mu <- 109
sigma <- 5

# Dominio
x <- seq(90, 128, length = 600)
fx <- dnorm(x, mu, sigma)

# Percentiles
probs <- c(0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90)
qs <- qnorm(probs, mu, sigma)

# Colores
cols <- c("#dc2626", "#f59e0b", "#166534",
          "#f59e0b", "#dc2626")

labs <- c("P10", "Q1", "Mediana", "Q3", "P90")

# Márgenes
par(
  mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 1),
  family = "sans"
)

# Base del gráfico
plot(
  x, fx,
  type = "n",
  ylim = c(0, max(fx) * 1.15),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  main = "Percentiles en una distribución Normal",
  cex.main = 1.4,
  cex.lab = 1.2,
  cex.axis = 1.05
)

# Cuadrícula
grid(col = "gray90")

# Área bajo la curva
polygon(
  c(min(x), x, max(x)),
  c(0, fx, 0),
  col = adjustcolor("#bfdbfe", alpha.f = 0.6),
  border = NA
)

# Curva normal
lines(
  x, fx,
  lwd = 4,
  col = "#1e3a8a"
)

# Percentiles
for(i in seq_along(qs)){

  abline(
    v = qs[i],
    col = cols[i],
    lwd = 2.8,
    lty = 2
  )

  points(
    qs[i],
    dnorm(qs[i], mu, sigma),
    pch = 19,
    cex = 1.4,
    col = cols[i]
  )

  text(
    qs[i],
    dnorm(qs[i], mu, sigma) + 0.01,
    labels = labs[i],
    col = cols[i],
    cex = 1,
    font = 2
  )
}

# Línea de la media
abline(
  v = mu,
  col = "#111827",
  lwd = 2,
  lty = 3
)

# Leyenda
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c(
    "P10 y P90",
    "Q1 y Q3",
    "Mediana",
    "Media"
  ),
  col = c(
    "#dc2626",
    "#f59e0b",
    "#166534",
    "#111827"
  ),
  lwd = c(2.8, 2.8, 2.8, 2),
  lty = c(2,2,2,3),
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1
)
```
